title: Important: please read
lead: LearningLinks is only a connection website.
full: We do not carry out background checks on teachers, schools or families, and we do not verify identity, credentials, licences or work permits. Everyone is responsible for completing all checks and for following all government laws, policies and procedures that apply to them.
short: We only connect people. We do not run background checks on anyone. Please complete all checks and follow all government policies and procedures yourself.
acknowledge: I understand that LearningLinks is only a connection website, that it does not perform background checks on teachers, schools or families, and that I am responsible for all checks and for following all government laws, policies and procedures that apply to me.
substituteWork: Substitute work must follow work-permit and licensing rules. Foreign teachers may need permission to work for each school. Check before you accept.
tutoringWork: Private tutoring may not be allowed on some work permits. Check the rules that apply to you before you offer or book lessons.
chat: Do not send ID numbers, passport numbers or other sensitive documents in chat. LearningLinks does not review or store documents.
